<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary deadlock:</strong> Both Houses of Parliament faced repeated adjournments as the Opposition continued to demand a statement from Home Minister Amit Shah regarding recent student protests, despite government assurances that it is prepared to address the matter.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxNdW1qbGl6ZnBtS2wwTU14Y2pua0pGZ0dSYWtFTXZ0MFNvUExZOWsyN1FiMnNTeUN6UlFtQUMxWFlQUHJGNmNsZ282WmZXR1pOWXlzTUJQcFNnNDg0TmwxLU43bFRoR0dxMG9KNW13UEhMWVJUcF8waExseTkyWHBBUThmUEdZUHJaelI4RlAzaFJkOG03QlpjWjRwdmZQcTYtX0NIZ3pSaFZVVTVWTG85U2kwZ1htY1E?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNazQ2ajdpVW04c012WE9lRjJhdk50MTUtU0tFSDNlZ2VCRnFJaHlHWmFOa1hZc1pEaHhwbGM5YjBxNGRXdG5LTWk2TDdsay1zUDM5VGxaX1hsQnVmdWJKZVJXREMtUFQ4X191UzgxMDQ2SmpSOVowWHB4S2l4MWRXX0xLRmxPaDhzUWVJUWlR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative activity:</strong> Amidst the ongoing protests, the government introduced four key bills in the Lok Sabha, including legislation to rename Kerala, while the Opposition signaled its intent to challenge specific proposals like the FCRA and Delimitation bills.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
